name: Sentiment analysis
short_description: Sentiment analysis estimates whether a conversation appears positive, neutral or negative; in customer service it gives agents a signal to listen more carefully, not a verdict.

evidence.quote: A sentiment signal tries to show whether the conversation appears positive, neutral, or negative.
But when you move from transcription into sentiment and emotion, reliability drops
By the time a sentiment or a struggle reaches your desk, the Y has been completely stripped away.
